description: The cause is in another account: the platform team's bucket (account 111111111111, deployed separately, not in the agent's files) lets the project's account write only under teams/${aws:PrincipalTag/team}/, and the usage-report role has no team tag. The role already allows writing under teams/analytics/ and the README names that prefix, so nothing in the project points to the cause. The fix is to tag the role team=analytics; widening the role, writing elsewhere or adding a bucket policy fail. The execution history and the logs say only that no resource-based policy allows s3:PutObject, and the agent's AWS CLI runs as the project's account, which can't read the bucket policy, as on AWS. App Inspector shows the TeamPrefixes statement with its policy variable. Tool use is reported, not graded.
prompt: The monthly usage report never arrives. This project runs against LocalStack: ./deploy.sh deploys template.yaml and ./trigger.sh runs the workflow. Find out why, fix the project, deploy your fix and confirm it works.
